name: Barbell Clean
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, hinge with bent knees and a flat back, and take a shoulder-width overhand hook grip.
Push firmly through your feet to lift the bar close past your knees, then extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively.
Pull yourself rapidly under the rising bar into a full front squat while whipping your elbows forward to catch it across your shoulders.
Drive smoothly out of the squat to stand tall, then lower the bar under control to your thighs and the floor.
tips: Keep the bar sweeping close to your legs throughout the pull and keep your arms straight until full hip extension.
Receive the bar with high elbows and an upright torso so the weight rests securely across your front shoulders.
